data.body: RCA before fix: the two confirmed unbounded shapes remain present at origin/main. autodeploy.sh bounds fetch with FETCH_TIMEOUT but the first-run mirror bootstrap still calls git clone directly under the deploy lock; rebar-autodeploy.service TimeoutStartSec=90 prevents infinite timer latch but every missing-mirror tick can still consume the whole service budget. install-certbot-timer.sh renders certbot-renew.service as Type=oneshot with no TimeoutStartSec; if certbot renew hangs, systemd leaves the renewal unit activating and later timer firings do not start a new renewal. I am reusing the existing timeout idioms rather than adding new mechanisms.
